'''Albacete Balompié''' is a [[List of football clubs in Spain|Spanish football team]] based in [[Albacete]], in the autonomous community of [[Castile–La Mancha]]. Founded on 1 June 1939, it currently plays in [[Segunda División]], the second tier of Spanish football, holding home matches at ''[[Estadio Carlos Belmonte]]'', with a capacity of 17,524.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://footballtripper.com/spain/albacete-balompie-stadium/|title=Estadio Carlos Belmonte – Albacete Stadium Guide |date=2014-08-16|website=Football Tripper|language=en-GB|access-date=2020-01-05}}</ref>"}}
